title: NAFEMS LE10, thick plate under pressure
description: Quarter of a thick elliptic plate: inner ellipse (x/2)^2 + (y/1)^2 = 1, outer ellipse (x/3.25)^2 + (y/2.75)^2 = 1 (metres), 0.6 m thick (z from -0.3 to 0.3), steel (E 210 GPa, nu 0.3), 1 MPa pressure on the top face. Outer curved face held in x and y; the mid-plane edge on the outer face held in z; symmetry on the x and y planes. Target: sigma_yy at D (2, 0, 0.3).
description_check: Boundary conditions to be checked against TNSB Rev. 3.
not_modelled: fea_setup cannot express these supports: fixed_faces hold a face in x, y and z, and sliding_faces take only flat faces facing along an axis. LE10 needs the curved outer face held in x and y only, and an edge held in z (the outer face's mid-plane line, which exists only if that face is split at z = 0).

quantities.label: sigma_yy at D (2, 0, 0.3), top face
quantities.citation: NAFEMS, The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks, TNSB Rev. 3, 1990, test LE10
quantities.tolerance_reason: Not run; set as for the LE1 fine mesh.
